all_modes_confirmed: All three new models are Mode 2 (monotonic bit-width scaling).

gpt_j_6b.note: Despite K_max = 18.15x at Layer 1 (higher than Qwen2-7B's 17.23x at Layer 0), GPT-J-6B remains firmly Mode 2 in bit-width sweep. Confirms the K/V asymmetry paper's natural control finding: Layer 0 position, not magnitude alone, triggers Mode 1 pathology.

phi_3_medium_4k.note: Absolute ΔPPL +0.110 is the SECOND smallest in our sample, but because baseline PPL is very low (2.13), percentage is 5.2%. An alternative absolute-ΔPPL metric would classify this as production-quality. Interesting: nsep+pchan INT2 (+9.36) is much worse than naive INT2 (+4.78), the only case where naive beats nsep+pchan at INT2 among instruction-tuned models.

seven_model_final_dichotomy.int3_nsep_pchan_production_rate: 5 of 7 achieve < 5% ΔPPL, 6 of 7 achieve < 15% (excluding Pythia base model)
seven_model_final_dichotomy.key_observation: Mode 1 (INT4 valley of death) is singular and rare. Mode 2 is the universal pattern. INT3 nsep+pchan delivers production quality on Mode 1 AND on instruction-tuned Mode 2 models.

int4_int5_ratio_interpretation_note: Raw INT4/INT5 ratio can be misleading when absolute INT4 damage is tiny. A model like Mistral-7B shows ratio 13.7x, but INT4 naive damage is only +0.02 — firmly clean Mode 2. Refined Mode 1 definition: ratio >= 100x AND INT4 absolute damage >= 1.0. Only Qwen2-7B (ratio 294x, INT4 +1382) meets both criteria.
